content: IndexedDB is asynchronous browser storage for structured objects and indexed queries; use Dexie 4.4.7 to simplify schema and versioned transactions. Do not store canonical data only in localStorage: its quota is 5 MiB per origin and browser best-effort storage may be removed, so clearly disclose local-only persistence and plan user export/backup. Sources: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/IndexedDB_API https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Storage_API/Storage_quotas_and_eviction_criteria https://dexie.org/docs/ https://www.npmjs.com/package/dexie
